_doc: TM96-TM104 at items 120-128 (b2tools/patches/new_tms.py writes this file: python3 new_tms.py --text). Descriptions = the move's own (0402), as Black 2's TMs.

system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.120: The user focuses its mind before\nlaunching a punch. It will fail if the user\nis hit before it is used.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.121: The user attacks the target with\na pulsing blast of water.\nIt may also confuse the target.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.122: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the\ntarget. Two to five seeds are shot in\nrapid succession.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.123: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's\nHP is restored by half the damage\ntaken by the target.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.124: The target is slammed with a steel-hard\ntail. It may also lower the target's\nDefense stat.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.125: The user strikes the target with a quick\njolt of electricity.\nThis attack cannot be evaded.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.126: The user attacks the target with a\nsecret power. Its added effects vary\ndepending on the user's environment.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.127: The target is hit with wings of steel.\nIt may also raise the user's Defense stat.
system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.128: The user employs its psychic power to\nexchange Abilities with the target.
